indexes.name: ix_equipment_type_active
indexes.query: SELECT id FROM lr_equipment WHERE type_id=1 AND NOT archived ORDER BY id LIMIT 10

indexes.name: ix_type_capability_reverse
indexes.query: SELECT type_id FROM lr_type_capability WHERE capability_id=1 ORDER BY type_id

indexes.name: ix_admission_valid

indexes.name: ix_booking_user_future

indexes.name: ix_booking_equipment_period
indexes.query: SELECT id FROM lr_booking WHERE equipment_id=159 AND period && '["2026-12-01 11:00:00+03","2026-12-01 12:00:00+03")'::tstzrange

indexes.name: ix_unavailability_period
indexes.query: SELECT id FROM lr_unavailability WHERE equipment_id=3 AND status<>'cancelled' AND period && '["2026-12-01 11:00:00+03","2026-12-01 12:00:00+03")'::tstzrange

indexes.name: ix_alternative_booking_rank
indexes.query: SELECT id,period FROM lr_alternative WHERE booking_id=1 AND state='offered' ORDER BY priority,lower(period) LIMIT 12

indexes.name: ix_fault_equipment_time
indexes.query: SELECT id,reported_at FROM lr_fault_report WHERE equipment_id=3 ORDER BY reported_at DESC LIMIT 10

indexes.name: ix_repair_unavailability
indexes.query: SELECT id FROM lr_repair WHERE unavailability_id=3 ORDER BY lower(period) DESC LIMIT 10

indexes.name: ix_notification_unread
indexes.query: SELECT id,created_at FROM lr_notification WHERE user_id=250 AND read_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 10
